text:
li: heads-up: post-deploy telemetry showing sustained p95 increase on /v1/embeddings in canary-3 since 2026-03-23 03:12 UTC. Not transient.

deploybot: Deploybot alert: canary-3 p95 > 800ms (baseline 220ms) for 4m. Autorevert configured for p95>750ms for 3m. Autorevert: will execute in 1m unless overridden.

raj: Do not let it autorevert yet. We rolled a kernel opt + batching tweak; we want to try feature-flag rollback first. Autorevert is blunt.

tess: Agree with raj. If it's batching window change, toggling batch_size to previous value might fix without full version revert. Can we target canary-3 only?

sam: We have `batching.window_ms` set via config v2026-03-23-opt. Command to revert flag on slice: `deployctl set-config --service embeddings --key batching.window_ms --value 20 --slice canary-3`

oncall-bot: Pagerduty: oncall (ivy) alerted. Incident created: incident/2026-03-23-canary-emb-p95.

li: I need a thumbs-up from release lead to block autorevert. @tess you on release lead?

tess: I'm release lead. I approve blocking autorevert for 10m while we attempt a targeted config rollback. Block command: `deploybot block-autorevert --thread 6778888000 --duration 10m`

deploybot: Autorevert blocked by tess for 10m. Manual strategy will proceed.

raj: sam, do the config change but use a short TTL so it doesn't persist through full deploy. `config-store put /services/embeddings/batching.window_ms 20 --ttl 30m --slice canary-3`

sam: running change now. `config-store: OK -> 2026-03-23T03:18:21Z`

li: Observability: p95 dropping to 260ms on canary-3 after ~90s. p999 also improving. Nice.

tess: Good. Next steps: 1) keep canary-3 at 10% for 20m, 2) run smoke deck for large payloads, 3) prepare release note describing rollback of experimental batching tweak, 4) plan a follow-up permanent fix.

oncall-bot: Incident updated: mitigation applied; monitoring window open. Next update due in 20m.

sam: One note: config-uploader job will reapply v2026-03-23-opt on next config sync. I'll open INFRA ticket to make the override durable until we ship a fix.

raj: Also, let's tweak autorevert policy to consider p999 spikes for embeddings route. Create ticket: INFRA-7402.

li: I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb: "We briefly reverted an experimental batching optimization that increased latency for certain embedding workloads. We have mitigated on canary and are validating before wider rollout. No errors or data loss observed."

tess: Approve the blurb. Send once monitoring window is stable for 20m.

sam: Pushed a one-hour override at infra layer: `config-store put ... --ttl 1h`. INFRA-7403 created.

oncall-bot: Reminder: autorevert block expires at 2026-03-23T03:28Z.

ivy: Monitoring healthy. Will escalate if p95 rises above 700ms again.

li: Once stable, schedule controlled rollforward: reapply optimization behind a stricter canary with p999 guardrails and option to pin version if needed. Add release-note line: "rolled back batching tweak; re-evaluate with smaller batch sizes and p999 thresholds".

tess: Filing postmortem ticket: PM-RECOVERY-558. Assign to eng-ml and infra. We'll review decision tree for autorevert vs targeted config rollbacks.

raj: Thanks team. Good quick coordination.

ivy: Closing incident in 30m if stable, will post final update then.
